inventory.units_note: declared query rows are not inventory case rows; inventory case rows become arm-expanded metric rows by variants x layers x kind-eligible arms

exact_key_value_diagnostic.note: mixture diagnostic over a gold key readout; exact-key rows exist only for fact targets and are never added to candidate quality

oracle_diagnostic.note: gold-target diagnostic population, not an upper bound

diagnostics.note: When refresh evidence is absent, causal/oracle blocks are explicit full-state or mixture fallbacks; equality is reported, not hidden. Runtime selection metrics are unavailable when the raw artifact predates decision rows.
